asciichat_error_t kitty_image_write (FILE * stream, const uint8_t * rgba, int width, int height, int pitch)

Transmit packed RGBA pixels using Kitty's direct, chunked graphics protocol. Padding at the end of each input row is excluded. The stream remains caller-owned.
